display_long_description:
# Squirrel Battle starts here!
RUNuts is a FREE social VR hero shooter where every squirrel Champion brings a different way to battle.

Download now to become an OG Glider, play with other Gliders, and join our community at discord.gg/runuts
[media]
# 🎖️ Brawl your way to the TOP
Choose your Champion, take flight, and battle other Gliders in Brawl Mode
[media]
# ⚔️ Every Champion plays different
Dash through enemies as Tetsu, blast a massive beam as Squirzilla, or blow up the battlefield with Rocco’s rocket launcher.
[media]
# 🐿️ Your squirrel. Your style.
Gentleman, DJ, and more, customize your squirrel and make your look your own.
[media]
# Play during Limited Access
RUNuts is in Limited Access, open every Friday and Saturday for a limited time.
Join Discord.gg/runuts for OG cosmetics, other Gliders to play with, and the latest event news.
